item.title: With her velvet voice and her astounding lyrics, Elysia Biro tak...
item.description: With her velvet voice and her astounding lyrics, Elysia Biro takes us somewhere we’ve never been before. The Canadian singer, classically trained in piano from the age of four, blends jazz, classical music, and pop into a sound entirely her own, one that moves us to tears. From jazz festivals to iconic venues, her voice is inescapable. She recently released her excellent debut EP, Running From Nothing, and now talks to us in more depth about the record and what’s next for her.Words by : @lynaalltShot by : @sabrabinder
